observations.text: An overturned inkwell — not cleaned up. Someone left this desk in considerable haste.
observations.journal_entry: The inkwell at Harlow's desk has been knocked over and left to dry. Something rattled him recently.

observations.text: Papers in the waste basket — the top sheet is partially burnt. I can make out the words 'destroy all correspondence.'
observations.journal_entry: Someone — almost certainly Harlow — attempted to burn an instruction reading 'destroy all correspondence.' He was methodically cleaning house.

observations.text: Fresh scratch marks around the wall safe — it was opened recently, and apparently in some haste.
observations.board_label: Wall safe — recently opened in haste
observations.journal_entry: The safe behind Harlow's bookshelf shows fresh scratch marks consistent with a hasty combination attempt. Documents may have been removed or concealed.
